description:
Fetch the github.com/trending page for the most-starred repos in a time window, optionally filtered by language. Pure HTTP (no browser). Returns full name, URL, description, language, total stars, stars this window, forks.

upAPI operation `github-trending.get` (Developer Tools). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

language.description: Programming language slug (python, rust, typescript, go, …). Empty = any language.

name: github_trending_get
title: Get GitHub Trending Repositories
